instrument: decision comparison: the orchestrator's next ledger lines and log command on recorded final-review states, orko-sdd v0.1.3 vs v0.1.4
case_source: v0.1.3 clean-room run 2026-10-10, fix re-review subagent agent-a69307cd3b358f47c; build_cases.py derives the variants

1-important.v0.1.4_expected: superseding ruling, then `log --task final --role final-refixer --model opus --effort high`
1-important.v0.1.3_expected: a `Task final: parked` line, no refixer

2-minor.v0.1.4_expected: a `Task final: minor (deferred)` line, no refixer

3-not-addressed.v0.1.4_expected: a `Task final: parked` line, no refixer

4-after-refix.v0.1.4_expected: a `Task final: parked` line, no second refixer

5-mixed.v0.1.4_expected: a refixer sent only the new-breakage item, and a `parked` line for the NOT ADDRESSED finding

pass_rule: v0.1.4 3/3 on cases 1, 4, 5 and >=2/3 on 2, 3; v0.1.3 parks case 1 in >=2/3
